label: Home Assistant Green home automation hub
description: Home Assistant Green is the plug-and-play Home Assistant appliance (Rockchip RK3566, 4 GB RAM, 32 GB eMMC) with the web UI and local APIs on port 8123. It has exactly one network interface - a Gigabit Ethernet port - and no WiFi at all, so it must be cabled; it ships without any Zigbee/Thread radio (a Connect ZBT-2 USB dongle is needed for that), and USB is not modelled here.
